Who I am

I'm a Computer Engineering student specializing in Networks & Security, with a curiosity for exploring how technology works across different fields. My interests span networking, cybersecurity, OT, IT, web development, AI, data analysis, and digital transformation.

I enjoy learning through hands-on projects and continuously expanding my technical skills. I'm especially interested in how technology can connect people, systems, and data to solve problems, improve processes, and drive digital transformation.
